section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Cruise Control System
title: CONTINUED FROM PREVIOUS PAGE

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for cruise control system troubleshooting, starting from previous page and continuing through multiple test points including control switch, accel/resume switch, stop light switch, release valve circuit, computer diagnostics, power source check, and ground connection

steps.text: Is there continuity between terminal 30 and body ground with set/coast switch turned off?
Is there continuity between terminal 28 and body ground when accel/resume switch turned on?
Disconnect connector from computer. Is resistance value about 68 Ω between terminal 1 and terminal 2 of computer with brake pedal returned?

items: Open or short circuit in wire harness between terminal 4 of stop light switch and terminal 3 of actuator.
Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 1 of actuator and terminal 2 of computer.

steps.text: Is there continuity between terminals 1 and 2 with brake pedal depressed?
Disconnect computer and inspect connector on wire harness side as follows.
Is there battery voltage between terminal 7 and body ground with main switch turned on?
steps.no: Open or short circuit in wire harness between terminal 7 of computer and terminal 3 of main switch.

steps.text: Is there continuity between terminal 10 and body ground?

items: Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 10 and body ground.
